capabilities: Browse a calendar with daily notes and generate weekly/monthly report skeletons from diary drafts
Auto-scan project folders and organize them with editable categories and tags
Aggregate checkbox todos from multiple sources with write-back to the source file
Schedule phases and milestones on a drag-and-drop Gantt chart synced with README files
Browse Feishu Wiki/Drive and view, archive, or resume Claude Code and CodeM sessions
disambiguation: Not an AI coding tool; the Sessions tab only visualizes and archives Claude Code session records stored on disk.
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. The Feishu tab calls Feishu cloud APIs through the external lark-cli tool using the user's own credentials; all other processing is local.
problem: Obsidian has no unified dashboard for daily planning, project tracking, task aggregation, and timeline views, so users juggle separate panels for each.

relations.evidence: Feishu Wiki / Drive browsing, project categorization, link checks, smart meeting notes
Visualize Claude Code and CodeM sessions, group by project, archive & harvest status

summary: Multi-tab dashboard plugin combining a calendar with daily notes, project scanning, todo aggregation, a Gantt chart, Feishu browsing, and Claude Code session viewing.
